planning_notes: Timer/refresh cadence: temperature display is refreshed every 2 seconds; business logic and numeric mapping (e.g., scaling/rounding and DHT invalid behavior on display) belong in the SysML model, not in device requests.

One DHT sensor is wired to D7 and both temperature/humidity/validity requests share that same physical pin and sample timing in the model (sensor sample_period_ms >= 2000ms, single coherent acquisition frame).
TM1637 wiring uses clk=D4 and dio=D5 as specified. Display numeric update behavior on invalid reads is handled by SysML using dht_valid and tm1637 invalid_policy blank.
No serial reporting or command/control requirements were provided, so serial_channels is empty.
No other explicit electrical requirements (GPIOs, PWM, tones, servos, shift registers, ultrasonic) were provided; therefore no additional port objects are created.
